description: Mode of a file or directory created under a umask. A file starts from 666 and a directory from 777, then the umask bits are cleared. 022 makes a file 644 and a directory 755. masked lists the bits the umask turns off. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/umask-mode
name: umask_mode
title: Umask Mode
